comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Holland Village MRT about 1,100 m, Buona Vista MRT about 1,270 m; closer than 1 of 551 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 2 within 2 km; nearest Henry Park Primary School about 610 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 420 m), more than 34 of 551 similar developments (the same as 38); nearest hawker centre Ghim Moh Road Blk 20 about 870 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 440 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Maju MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,690 m, under construction; LTA target 2032. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 7 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 810 m; Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 1,050 m; Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 1,470 m; Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 1,590 m; Nava Grove, 77 new sales, about 1,600 m; Dunearn House, 237 new sales, about 1,710 m; The Hill @One-North, 14 new sales, about 1,760 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 96 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,087 new sales and 459 resales (1,546 purchases); new sales were 70.3% of these purchases. Subsales (23) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,060 m; Dunearn Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,750 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 459 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 107 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 459 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 494 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.1%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
